verdict.rationale: Importing mail and contacts is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no Outlook import feature for mail history or contacts from another provider or client. The Graph API mail, sync and attachment endpoints are developer building blocks, not an import capability. The community readpst/libpst note describes exporting out of Outlook to other clients, which is the opposite direction.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
